sourceDate.text: 咸康七年後明年及隨後紀事
咸康七年後明年及隨後紀事
咸康七年後明年及隨後紀事

units.zh: 慕容皝
units.en: Murong Huang.
units.literal: Murong Huang.

units.zh: 慕容皝，字元真，廆第三子也。
units.en: Murong Huang, whose courtesy name was Yuanzhen, was Murong Hui’s third son.
units.literal: Murong Huang, courtesy name Yuanzhen, was the third son of Murong Hui.

units.zh: 龍顏版齒，身長七尺八寸。
units.en: He had an imperial bearing, unusually square teeth, and stood seven feet eight inches tall.
units.literal: Dragon face and “plaque” teeth; body height seven chi eight cun.

units.zh: 雄毅多權略，尚經學，善天文。
units.en: He was bold, resourceful, devoted to the classics, and adept at reading the stars.
units.literal: Heroic and resolute, abundant in stratagem; esteemed classical learning; skilled in astronomy.

units.zh: 廆為遼東公，立為世子。
units.en: When Murong Hui was named duke of Liaodong, Huang was made his heir.
units.literal: When Hui became Duke of Liaodong, he was established as heir apparent.

units.zh: 建武初，拜為冠軍將軍、左賢王，封望平侯，率眾征討，累有功。
units.en: Early in the Jianwu era he was named general who champions the army and left worthy prince, created marquis of Wangping, and led troops on several successful expeditions.
units.literal: At the beginning of Jianwu, appointed General Who Champions the Army, Left Worthy Prince, enfeoffed Marquis of Wangping; led host in campaigns; repeatedly had merit.

units.zh: 太甯末，拜平北將軍，進封朝鮮公。
units.en: Late in the Taining era he became general who pacifies the north and was promoted to duke of Chaoxian.
units.literal: At the end of Taining, appointed General Who Pacifies the North; advanced enfeoffment to Duke of Chaoxian.

units.zh: 廆卒，嗣位，以平北將軍行平州刺史，督攝部內。
units.en: When Hui died he succeeded him, serving as general who pacifies the north and acting governor of Pingzhou with authority over the whole command.
units.literal: When Hui died, he succeeded the position; as general who pacifies the north acted as governor of Ping Province, supervising and holding the interior of the command.

units.zh: 尋而宇文乞得龜為其別部逸豆歸所逐，奔死於外，皝率騎討之，逸豆歸懼而請和，遂築榆陰、安晉二城而還。
units.en: Soon afterward Yuwen Qidegui was driven out by a rival kinsman, Yidougui, and died in exile; Huang led cavalry against Yidougui, who sued for peace; Huang then built Yuyin and Anjin and withdrew.
units.literal: Soon Yuwen Qidegui was by his separate division Yidougui expelled, fled and died outside; Huang led cavalry to campaign against him; Yidougui feared and requested peace; thereupon built the two cities of Yuyin and Anjin and returned.

units.zh: 初，皝庶兄建威翰驍武有雄才，素為皝所忌，母弟征虜仁、廣武昭並有寵於廆，皝亦不平之。
units.en: His elder half-brother Murong Han, who held the title general who establishes might, was a brilliant warrior whom Huang resented, while his full brothers Murong Ren and Murong Zhao, both favored by Hui, also stirred his jealousy.
units.literal: In the beginning, Huang’s elder half-brother by a concubine, Jianwei Han, was fierce in arms and had heroic talent; he had long been envied by Huang; younger brothers by the same mother, Ren the Campaign General and Zhao the Guangwu general, both had favor with Hui; Huang also was not even toward them.

units.zh: 及廆卒，並懼不自容。
units.en: When Hui died they all feared for their lives.
units.literal: When Hui died, all feared they could not preserve themselves.

units.zh: 至此，翰出奔段遼，仁勸昭舉兵廢皝。
units.en: Murong Han fled to Duan Liao, while Murong Ren urged Murong Zhao to revolt and depose Huang.
units.literal: Reaching this point, Han fled out to Duan Liao; Ren urged Zhao to raise troops and depose Huang.

units.zh: 皝殺昭，遣使按檢仁之虛實，遇仁於險瀆。
units.en: Huang executed Zhao and sent envoys to probe whether Ren’s situation was genuine; they encountered Ren at Xiandu.
units.literal: Huang killed Zhao, sent envoys to investigate the truth of Ren’s situation, met Ren at Xiandu.

units.zh: 仁知事發，殺皝使，東歸平郭。
units.en: Ren saw his plot exposed, killed the messenger, and fled east to Pingguo.
units.literal: Ren knew the affair had broken; killed Huang’s envoy; went east to return to Pingguo.

units.zh: 皝遣其弟建武幼、司馬佟壽等討之。
units.en: Huang dispatched his brother Murong You and Marshal Tong Shou against him.
units.literal: Huang sent his younger brother Jianwu You, marshal Tong Shou, and others to campaign against him.

units.zh: 仁盡眾距戰，幼等大敗，皆沒於仁。
units.en: Ren threw his whole army into the fight and crushed You’s force, capturing every commander.
units.literal: Ren exhausted the host to resist battle; You and the others were greatly defeated, all lost to Ren.

units.zh: 襄平令王冰、將軍孫機以遼東叛於皝，東夷校尉封抽、護軍乙逸、遼東相韓矯、玄菟太守高詡等棄城奔還。
units.en: Magistrate Wang Bing of Xiangping and general Sun Ji turned Liaodong against him, while Feng Chou, Yi Yi, Han Jiao, Gao Xu, and others abandoned their posts and fled.
units.literal: Xiangping magistrate Wang Bing and general Sun Ji rebelled in Liaodong against Huang; Eastern Yi Colonel Feng Chou, protector Yi Yi, Liaodong chancellor Han Jiao, Xuantu prefect Gao Xu, and others abandoned cities and fled back.

units.zh: 仁於是盡有遼左之地，自稱車騎將軍、平州刺史、遼東公。
units.en: Ren then controlled all territory east of the Liao, proclaiming himself general of chariots and cavalry, governor of Pingzhou, and duke of Liaodong.
units.literal: Ren thereupon wholly possessed the land left of the Liao, styled himself General of Chariots and Cavalry, governor of Ping Province, Duke of Liaodong.

units.zh: 宇文歸、段遼及鮮卑諸部並為之援，
units.en: Yuwen Gui, Duan Liao, and other Xianbei chiefs backed him.
units.literal: Yuwen Gui, Duan Liao, and the various Xianbei divisions all became his aid.

units.zh: 咸和九年，皝遣其司馬封弈攻鮮卑木堤于白狼，揚威淑虞攻烏丸悉羅侯于平岡，皆斬之。
units.en: In the ninth year of Xianhe, Huang sent Marshal Feng Yi to strike the Xianbei leader Muti at Bailang and Shuyu to strike the Wuhuan Siluohou at Pinggang; both enemy heads were taken.
units.literal: In the ninth year of Xianhe, Huang sent his marshal Feng Yi to attack the Xianbei Muti at Bailang, and Yangwei Shuyu to attack the Wuhuan Siluohou at Pinggang; both were beheaded.

units.zh: 材官劉佩攻乙連，不克。
units.en: Engineering officer Liu Pei assaulted Yilian without success.
units.literal: Workshop officer Liu Pei attacked Yilian but could not overcome it.

units.zh: 段遼遂寇徒河，皝將張萌逆擊，敗之。
units.en: Duan Liao then invaded Tuhe, but Huang’s general Zhang Meng intercepted and routed him.
units.literal: Duan Liao thereupon raided Tuhe; Huang’s general Zhang Meng met and struck them, defeated them.

units.zh: 遼弟蘭與翰寇柳城，都尉石琮擊敗之。
units.en: Duan Lan and Murong Han attacked Liucheng until commandant Shi Cong drove them off.
units.literal: Liao’s younger brother Lan with Han raided Liucheng; commandant Shi Cong struck and defeated them.

units.zh: 旬余，蘭、翰復圍柳城，皝遣甯遠慕容汗及封弈等救之。
units.en: Ten-odd days later Duan Lan and Murong Han, the kinsman who had joined Duan Liao, again besieged Liucheng; Huang sent the Ningyuan general, a different Murong Han, together with Feng Yi and others to relieve the city.
units.literal: After ten-odd days, Lan and Han again besieged Liucheng; Huang sent General Who Pacifies the Distance Murong Han and Feng Yi and others to rescue it.

units.zh: 皝戒汗曰：「賊眾氣銳，難與爭鋒，宜顧萬全，慎勿輕進，必須兵集陣整，然後擊之。」
units.en: Huang warned Murong Han (the general of pacifying distance): “The foe is numerous and keen—do not trade blows rashly; wait until your force is formed, then attack.”
units.literal: Huang warned Han, saying: “The bandits’ host is many and their spirit sharp; hard to contend edge; ought to look to complete safety, carefully do not lightly advance; must wait until troops are gathered and lines set, then strike them.”

units.zh: 汗性驍銳，遣千餘騎為前鋒而進，封弈止之，汗不從，為蘭所敗，死者大半。
units.en: Murong Han was impetuous: he sent a thousand horse ahead as a van, ignored Feng Yi’s warning, and was routed by Duan Lan with heavy losses.
units.literal: Han’s nature was fierce and sharp; dispatched over a thousand cavalry as vanguard to advance; Feng Yi stopped him; Han did not follow; was defeated by Lan; dead were more than half.

units.zh: 蘭復攻柳城，為飛梯、地道，圍守二旬，石琮躬勒將士出擊，敗之，斬首千五百級，蘭乃遁歸。
units.en: Duan Lan renewed the siege with ladders and tunnels, but after twenty days Shi Cong sallied forth, killed fifteen hundred men, and forced Lan to withdraw.
units.literal: Lan again attacked Liucheng, made flying ladders and tunnels, besieged and guarded twenty days; Shi Cong personally led officers and soldiers out to strike, defeated them, beheaded fifteen hundred grades; Lan then fled and returned.

units.zh: 是歲，成帝遣謁者徐孟、閭丘幸等持節拜皝鎮軍大將軍、平州刺史、大單于、遼東公，持節、都督、承制封拜，一如廆故事。
units.en: That year Emperor Cheng invested him as general who guards the army, governor of Pingzhou, great shanyu, and duke of Liaodong, with full authority to enfeoff subordinates as Hui had held.
units.literal: That year, Emperor Cheng sent attendants Xu Meng, Lüqiu Xing, and others bearing credentials to appoint Huang General Who Guards the Army, governor of Ping Province, Great Shanyu, Duke of Liaodong; bearer of credentials, overall commander, investiture by mandate on the model of Hui’s precedent.

units.zh: 皝自征遼東，克襄平。
units.en: Huang led the army in person and captured Xiangping.
units.literal: Huang personally campaigned Liaodong, took Xiangping.

units.zh: 仁所署居就令劉程以城降，新昌人張衡執縣宰以降。
units.en: Liu Cheng, whom Ren had installed at Juqiu, yielded the town, while Zhang Heng of Xinchang seized the magistrate and capitulated.
units.literal: Magistrate Liu Cheng of Juqiu, whom Ren had appointed, surrendered the city; a man of Xinchang, Zhang Heng, seized the county chief and surrendered.

units.zh: 於是斬仁所置守宰，分徙遼東大姓於棘城，置和陽、武次、西樂三縣而歸。
units.en: He executed Ren’s officials, relocated the leading Liaodong families to Jicheng, set up three new counties, and marched home.
units.literal: Thereupon executed Ren’s placed guardians and magistrates, divided and moved great clans of Liaodong to Jicheng, established the three counties of Heyang, Wuci, and Xile, and returned.

units.zh: 咸康初，遣封弈襲宇文別部涉奕於，大獲而還。
units.en: Early in Xiankang he sent Feng Yi against Sheyiyu of a separate Yuwen division and returned with rich spoils.
units.literal: At the beginning of Xiankang, sent Feng Yi to raid Yuwen’s separate division Sheyiyu; great capture and return.

units.zh: 涉奕于率騎追戰于渾水，又敗之。
units.en: Sheyiyu counterattacked at the Hun River and was beaten again.
units.literal: Sheyiyu led cavalry to pursue battle at Hunshui; again defeated them.

units.zh: 皝將乘海討仁，群下咸諫，以海道危陰，宜從陸路。
units.en: When Huang planned a seaborne strike on Ren, his advisers objected that the route was too perilous and urged a march by land.
units.literal: Huang was about to cross the sea to strike Ren; subordinates all remonstrated, because sea routes were dangerous and precipitous, ought to follow land route.

units.zh: 皝曰：「舊海水無淩，自仁反已來，凍合者三矣。
units.en: Huang replied, “This gulf seldom froze in the past, yet since Ren’s revolt it has frozen solid three winters running.
units.literal: Huang said: “Formerly the sea water had no ice; since Ren’s rebellion, the freeze has joined three times.

units.zh: 昔漢光武因滹沱之冰以濟大業，天其或者欲吾乘此而無之乎！
units.en: Han Guangwu once crossed the Hutuo on the ice to win his empire—Heaven may mean me to use this freeze against Ren!
units.literal: Formerly Han Guangwu relied on the Hutuo’s ice to accomplish the great enterprise; Heaven perhaps or desires me to ride this to destroy him!

units.zh: 吾計決矣，有沮謀者斬！」
units.en: My mind is made up; anyone who dissuades me dies!”
units.literal: My plan is decided; whoever obstructs the plan—beheaded!”

units.zh: 乃率三軍從昌黎踐淩而進。
units.en: He then marched the host across the frozen bay from Changli.
units.literal: Thereupon led the three armies from Changli treading the ice to advance.

units.zh: 仁不虞皝之至也，軍去平郭七里，候騎乃告，仁狼狽出戰，為皝所擒，殺仁而還。
units.en: Ren never expected him: Huang’s vanguard was seven li from Pingguo before Ren learned of it; Ren scrambled into battle, was taken, and executed.
units.literal: Ren did not expect Huang’s arrival; the army was seven li from Pingguo when patrol riders reported; Ren in confusion came out to fight, was captured by Huang; killed Ren and returned.

units.zh: 立藉田於朝陽門東，置官司以主之。
units.en: He set aside a ritual field east of the Chaoyang Gate and staffed it with officials.
units.literal: Established “helping-field” east of the Chaoyang Gate, set offices to supervise it.

units.zh: 段遼遣將李詠夜襲武興，遇雨，引還，都尉張萌追擊，擒詠。
units.en: Duan Liao’s night raid on Wuxing failed in the rain; Zhang Meng ran down Li Yong and captured him.
units.literal: Duan Liao sent general Li Yong to night-raid Wuxing; met rain, led back; commandant Zhang Meng pursued, captured Yong.

units.zh: 段蘭擁眾數萬屯於曲水亭，將攻柳城，宇文歸入寇安晉，為蘭聲援。
units.en: Duan Lan massed tens of thousands at Qushui to strike Liucheng while Yuwen Gui hit Anjin in coordination.
units.literal: Duan Lan led a host of several tens of thousands encamped at Qushui Pavilion, about to attack Liucheng; Yuwen Gui entered to raid Anjin as sounding support for Lan.

units.zh: 皝以步騎五萬擊之，師次柳城，蘭、歸皆遁。
units.en: Huang met them with fifty thousand foot and horse; Lan and Gui both fled when the army halted at Liucheng.
units.literal: Huang with infantry and cavalry fifty thousand struck them; army halted at Liucheng; Lan and Gui both fled.

units.zh: 遣封弈率輕騎追擊，敗之，收其軍實，館穀二旬而還。
units.en: Feng Yi chased with light horse, seized their supplies, and fed his men from enemy granaries for twenty days.
units.literal: Sent Feng Yi leading light cavalry to pursue, defeated them, gathered their military stores, lodged on their grain twenty days then returned.

units.zh: 謂諸將曰：「二虜恥無功而歸，必復重至，宜於柳城左右設伏以待之。」
units.en: He told his commanders, “They will return in force to save face—we should lay ambushes around Liucheng.”
units.literal: Said to the generals: “The two barbarians, shamed at returning without merit, surely will come again heavily; ought at Liucheng’s left and right to set ambush to await them.”

units.zh: 遣封弈率騎潛于馬兒山諸道。
units.en: Feng Yi hid cavalry along the Ma’er Mountain tracks.
units.literal: Sent Feng Yi leading cavalry to lurk on the roads of Ma’er Mountain.

units.zh: 俄而遼騎果至，弈夾擊，大敗之，斬其將榮保。
units.en: When Duan Liao’s riders appeared, Feng Yi caught them in a pincer, slew Rong Bao, and routed the column.
units.literal: Soon Liao’s cavalry indeed arrived; Yi attacked from both sides, greatly defeated them, beheaded their general Rong Bao.

units.zh: 遣兼長史劉斌、郎中令陽景送徐孟等歸於京師。
units.en: He sent Liu Bin and Yang Jing to escort Xu Meng’s party to the capital.
units.literal: Sent concurrent chief clerk Liu Bin, palace director Yang Jing to escort Xu Meng and others back to the capital.

units.zh: 使其世子俊伐段遼諸城，封弈攻宇文別部，皆大捷而歸。
units.en: His heir Murong Jun stormed Duan Liao’s towns while Feng Yi struck the Yuwen—both returned in triumph.
units.literal: Made his heir apparent Jun campaign against Duan Liao’s cities; Feng Yi attacked Yuwen’s separate division; both great victory and return.

units.zh: 立納諫之木，以開讜言之路。
units.en: He erected a public complaint board to invite candid advice.
units.literal: Set up a “wood for accepting remonstrance” to open the road of blunt speech.

units.zh: 後徙昌黎郡，築好城于乙連東，使將軍蘭勃戍之，以逼乙連。
units.en: He shifted his seat to Changli, built Haocheng east of Yilian, and stationed Lan Bo there to choke the enemy.
units.literal: Later moved Changli commandery, built Haocheng east of Yilian, had general Lan Bo garrison it, to press Yilian.

units.zh: 又城曲水，以為勃援。
units.en: He fortified Qushui to back Lan Bo.
units.literal: Also walled Qushui to serve as Bo’s support.

units.zh: 乙連饑甚，段遼輸之粟，蘭勃要擊獲之。
units.en: When Yilian starved, Duan Liao sent grain; Lan Bo seized the convoy.
units.literal: Yilian was extremely hungry; Duan Liao sent them grain; Lan Bo intercepted and captured it.

units.zh: 遼遣將屈雲攻興國，與皝將慕容遵大戰于五官水上，雲敗，斬之，盡俘其眾。
units.en: Qu Yun attacked Xingguo but Murong Zun destroyed him at Wuguan River and took his entire force.
units.literal: Liao sent general Qu Yun to attack Xingguo, with Huang’s general Murong Zun fought a great battle at Wuguan River; Yun was defeated, beheaded; all captured their host.

units.zh: 封弈等以皝任重位輕，宜稱燕王，皝於是以咸康三年僭即王位，赦其境內。
units.en: Feng Yi and others, holding that Huang’s burden was heavy while his rank was light, urged him to style himself King of Yan; Huang thereupon in the third year of Xiankang illegitimately assumed the kingship and pardoned those within his borders.
units.literal: Feng Yi and others because Huang’s burden was weighty yet rank was light, ought to style King of Yan; Huang thereupon in the third year of Xiankang illegitimately assumed kingship, pardoned those within his borders.

units.zh: 以封弈為國相，韓壽為司馬，裴開、陽騖、王寓、李洪、杜群、宋該、劉瞻、石琮、皇甫真、陽協、宋晃、平熙、張泓等並為列卿將帥。
units.en: He named Feng Yi chancellor, Han Shou marshal, and distributed ministerial and command posts among Pei Kai, Yang Wu, and the rest.
units.literal: Made Feng Yi state chancellor, Han Shou marshal, Pei Kai, Yang Wu, Wang Yu, Li Hong, Du Qun, Song Gai, Liu Zhan, Shi Cong, Huangfu Zhen, Yang Xie, Song Huang, Ping Xi, Zhang Hong and others concurrently ministers and generals.

units.zh: 起文昌殿，乘金根車，駕六馬，出入稱警蹕。
units.en: He built Wenchang Hall, rode the six-horse imperial carriage, and received full royal escorts.
units.literal: Raised the Wenchang Hall, rode the gold-root carriage, harnessed six horses, going out and entering called out “clear the way.”

units.zh: 以其妻段氏為王后，世子俊為太子，皆如魏武、晉文輔政故事。
units.en: He made Lady Duan queen and Murong Jun crown prince, citing Cao Cao and Sima Zhao as precedents.
units.literal: Made his wife Lady Duan queen, heir apparent Jun crown prince, all like Wei Wu and Jin Wen’s precedent of assisting government.

units.zh: 皝以段遼屢為邊患，遣將軍宋回稱籓于石季龍，請師討遼。
units.en: Troubled by Duan Liao, he sent Song Hui to submit to Shi Hu and beg for an allied expedition.
units.literal: Because Duan Liao repeatedly was a border trouble, sent general Song Hui to declare vassalage to Shi Jilong, requesting troops to strike Liao.

units.zh: 季龍於是總眾而至。
units.en: Shi Hu thereupon marched his whole host to join the war.
units.literal: Jilong thereupon assembled host and arrived.

units.zh: 皝率諸軍攻遼令支以北諸城，遼遣其將段蘭來距，大戰，敗之，斬級數千，掠五千餘戶而歸。
units.en: Huang stormed Duan Liao’s strongholds north of Lingzhi, crushed Duan Lan, took thousands of heads, and carried off more than five thousand households.
units.literal: Huang led the various armies to attack Liao’s cities north of Lingzhi; Liao sent his general Duan Lan to resist; great battle, defeated them, beheaded several thousand grades, plundered over five thousand households and returned.

units.zh: 季龍至徐無，遼奔密雲山。
units.en: Shi Hu reached Xuwu while Duan Liao fled into Miyun Mountain.
units.literal: Jilong reached Xuwu; Liao fled to Miyun Mountain.

units.zh: 季龍進入令支，怒皝之不會師也，進軍擊之，至於棘城，戎卒數十萬，四面進攻，郡縣諸部叛應季龍者三十六城。
units.en: Shi Hu entered Lingzhi, furious that Huang had not coordinated, drove on to Jicheng with hundreds of thousands of men; thirty-six towns went over to him.
units.literal: Jilong entered Lingzhi, angry that Huang had not joined forces, advanced army to strike him, reaching Jicheng; Rong soldiers several hundred thousand, four sides advanced attack; prefectures and counties various divisions rebelled responding to Jilong thirty-six cities.

units.zh: 相持旬餘，左右勸皝降。
units.en: After a fortnight’s siege his officers begged him to yield.
units.literal: Stood off over ten days; left and right urged Huang to surrender.

units.zh: 皝曰：「孤方取天下，何乃降人乎！」
units.en: Huang snapped, “I mean to seize the realm—why would I surrender?”
units.literal: Huang said: “I am about to take All under Heaven—how then become another’s surrendered man!”

units.zh: 遣子恪等率騎二千，晨出擊之。
units.en: He sent his son Ke and others with two thousand horse in a dawn sally.
units.literal: Sent sons Ke and others leading cavalry two thousand, dawn sortie struck them.

units.zh: 季龍諸軍驚擾，棄甲而遁。
units.en: Shi Hu’s host panicked and bolted, leaving their armor.
units.literal: Jilong’s various armies were alarmed and disturbed, cast armor and fled.

units.zh: 恪乘勝追之，斬獲三萬餘級，築戍凡城而還。
units.en: Murong Ke pursued, killed or captured thirty thousand, and fortified Fancheng on the withdrawal.
units.literal: Ke rode victory to pursue them, beheaded and captured over thirty thousand grades, built a fort at Fancheng and returned.

units.zh: 段遼遣使詐降于季龍，請兵應接。
units.en: Duan Liao feigned submission to Shi Hu and asked for an escort.
units.literal: Duan Liao sent envoys feigning surrender to Jilong, requesting troops to meet and escort.

units.zh: 季龍遣其將麻秋率眾迎遼，恪伏精騎七千於密雲山，大敗之，獲其司馬陽裕、將軍鮮于亮，擁段遼及其部眾以歸。
units.en: Shi Hu sent Ma Qiu to fetch him; Murong Ke ambushed seven thousand elite riders at Miyun, captured Yang Yu and Xianyu Liang, and brought Duan Liao in.
units.literal: Jilong sent his general Ma Qiu leading host to welcome Liao; Ke ambushed seven thousand picked cavalry at Miyun Mountain, greatly defeated them, captured their marshal Yang Yu, general Xianyu Liang, and led Duan Liao and his division host back.

units.zh: 帝又遣使進皝為征北大將軍、幽州牧，領平州刺史，加散騎常侍，增邑萬戶，持節、都督、單于、公如故。
units.en: The emperor again sent envoys to advance Huang as General Who Campaigns North, shepherd of You Province, concurrently governor of Ping Province, adding Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary and an increase of ten thousand households, with credentials, overall command, shanyu, and duke as before.
units.literal: The emperor again sent envoys to advance Huang as General Who Campaigns North, shepherd of You Province, concurrently governor of Ping Province, added Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary, increased fief ten thousand households; credentials, overall command, shanyu, duke as before.

units.zh: 皝前軍帥慕容評敗季龍將石成等於遼西，斬其將呼延晃、張支，掠千餘戶以歸。
units.en: Huang’s forward commander Murong Ping defeated Shi Hu’s generals Shi Cheng and others in Liaoxi, slew Huyan Huang and Zhang Zhi, and brought home more than a thousand households.
units.literal: Huang’s forward commander Murong Ping defeated Jilong’s generals Shi Cheng and others in Liaoxi, beheaded their generals Huyan Huang and Zhang Zhi, plundered over a thousand households and returned.

units.zh: 段遼謀叛，皝誅之。
units.en: When Duan Liao plotted revolt, Huang put him to death.
units.literal: Duan Liao plotted rebellion; Huang executed him.

units.zh: 季龍又使石成入攻凡城，不克，進陷廣城。
units.en: Shi Hu sent Shi Cheng against Fancheng without success but seized Guangcheng.
units.literal: Jilong again sent Shi Cheng to attack Fancheng, could not overcome it, advanced and took Guangcheng.

units.zh: 皝雖稱燕王，未有朝命，乃遣其長史劉祥獻捷京師，兼言權假之意，並請大舉討平中原。
units.en: Though he called himself king of Yan, the court had not recognized it, so he sent Liu Xiang to report victories, explain his provisional rule, and ask for a northern expedition.
units.literal: Although Huang styled King of Yan, there was yet no court command; thereupon sent his chief clerk Liu Xiang to present victory at the capital, concurrently stating the intent of provisional authority, and requesting a great campaign to pacify the Central Plain.

units.zh: 又聞庾亮薨，弟冰、翼繼為將相，乃表曰：臣究觀前代昏明之主，若能親賢並建，則功致升平；
units.en: When Murong Huang learned that Yu Liang had died and Yu Bing and Yu Yi held power, he submitted a memorial: I have studied wise and foolish rulers of past ages. When they favored the worthy and elevated them together, the realm rose to peace;
units.literal: Moreover, when he learned that Yu Liang had died and Yu Bing and Yu Yi had succeeded as generals and ministers, he submitted a memorial, saying: Your servant has closely observed the muddled and clear rulers of former ages; if they could treat the worthy with intimacy and elevate them together, then merit reached peaceful ascendancy;

units.zh: 若親黨后族，必有傾辱之禍。
units.en: when they favored kin and the empress's clan, overthrow and humiliation were sure to follow.
units.literal: If they favored kin and the empress's clan, disaster of overthrow and humiliation was sure to follow.

units.zh: 是以周之申伯號稱賢舅，以其身籓於外，不握朝權。
units.en: Shen Bo of Zhou was praised as a worthy maternal uncle because he held a frontier fief and did not grasp court power.
units.literal: Therefore Shen Bo of Zhou was called the worthy maternal uncle, because he was enfeoffed outside as a frontier lord and did not hold court power.

units.zh: 降及秦昭，足為令主，委信二舅，幾至亂國。
units.en: Even King Zhao of Qin, a capable ruler, trusted his two maternal uncles and nearly ruined the state.
units.literal: Descending to King Zhao of Qin, who was enough to be called a fine ruler, he entrusted his two maternal uncles and nearly brought the state to disorder.

units.zh: 逮于漢武，推重田蚡，萬機之要，無不決之。
units.en: Emperor Wu of Han elevated Tian Fen until every vital decision passed through him.
units.literal: Reaching Emperor Wu of Han, who elevated Tian Fen, none of the myriad affairs' essentials went undecided by him.

units.zh: 及蚡死後，切齒追恨。
units.en: After Fen died, the emperor gnashed his teeth in bitter regret.
units.literal: When Fen died, he gnashed his teeth in later regret.

units.zh: 成帝暗弱，不能自立，內惑豔妻，外恣五舅，卒令王莽坐取帝位。
units.en: Emperor Cheng was weak and could not stand alone; beguiled within by a beautiful consort and indulging the five maternal uncles without, he finally let Wang Mang seize the throne.
units.literal: Emperor Cheng was dim and weak, unable to stand on his own; inwardly confused by a beautiful wife, outwardly indulging the five maternal uncles, he finally let Wang Mang sit and take the imperial throne.

units.zh: 每覽斯事，孰不痛惋！
units.en: Reading such cases, who does not feel pain and regret!
units.literal: Each time one reads these affairs, who does not feel pain and regret!

units.zh: 設使舅氏賢若穰侯、王鳳，則但聞有二臣，不聞有二主。
units.en: If maternal uncles were worthy like the Marquis of Rang or Wang Feng, one would hear of two ministers, not two rulers.
units.literal: Suppose the maternal uncles were worthy like the Marquis of Rang and Wang Feng, then one would only hear of two ministers, not two lords.

units.zh: 若其不才，則有竇憲、梁冀之禍。
units.en: If they lacked talent, disasters like those of Dou Xian and Liang Ji followed.
units.literal: If they lacked talent, there were the disasters of Dou Xian and Liang Ji.

units.zh: 凡此成敗，亦既然矣。
units.en: The lesson of these successes and failures is already plain.
units.literal: All these successes and failures are already thus clear.

units.zh: 苟能易軌，可無覆墜。
units.en: Change course in time and collapse can be avoided.
units.literal: If one could change course, one could avoid overturn and collapse.

units.zh: 陛下命世天挺，當隆晉道，而遭國多難，殷憂備嬰，追述往事，至今楚灼。
units.en: Your Majesty is heaven-born to exalt Jin's Way, yet the state has met repeated calamity; grief presses on every side, and recalling the past still burns.
units.literal: Your Majesty is heaven-born to the age, destined to exalt Jin's Way, yet has encountered many hardships of state; deep grief presses on every side; recalling past affairs, to this day one burns with anguish.

units.zh: 跡其所由，實因故司空亮居元舅之尊，勢業之重，執政裁下，輕侮邊將，故令蘇峻、祖約不勝其忿，遂致敗國。
units.en: The root cause was the late Minister of Works Yu Liang: as chief maternal uncle he wielded overwhelming power, judged subordinates harshly, and insulted frontier generals until Su Jun and Zu Yue, unable to bear their rage, ruined the state.
units.literal: Tracing where it came from, it was truly because the late Minister of Works Yu Liang occupied the honor of chief maternal uncle and the weight of power and achievement, governed and judged subordinates, and lightly insulted frontier generals, so that Su Jun and Zu Yue could not contain their rage and thus brought disaster on the state.

units.zh: 至今太后發憤，一旦升遐。
units.en: The Empress Dowager has died in indignation.
units.literal: Until now the Empress Dowager gave vent to her indignation and in one morning ascended to distant heaven.

units.zh: 若社稷不靈，人神無助，豺狼之心當可極邪！
units.en: Had the altars not been numinous and heaven not aided us, would the hearts of wolves and jackals have been allowed to run their course!
units.literal: If the altars were not numinous and men and spirits gave no aid, would the heart of wolves and jackals be allowed to reach its limit!

units.zh: 前事不忘，後事之表，而中書監、左將軍冰等內執樞機，外擁上將，昆弟並列，人臣莫疇。
units.en: Past affairs are not forgotten, yet Yu Bing as directorate counselor and left general, with his brothers, inwardly holds the pivot and outwardly commands armies, unmatched among ministers.
units.literal: Past affairs are not forgotten, the model for later affairs, yet Directorate Counselor and Left General Yu Bing and others inwardly hold the pivot, outwardly hold supreme command; brothers stand side by side, no minister has a peer.

units.zh: 陛下深敦渭陽，冰等自宜引領。
units.en: Your Majesty deeply honors family ties; Bing and his brothers ought to withdraw of their own accord.
units.literal: Your Majesty deeply honors the ties of Weiyang; Bing and the others ought themselves to withdraw.

units.zh: 臣常謂世主若欲崇顯舅氏，何不封以籓國，豐其祿賜，限其勢利，使上無偏優，下無私論。
units.en: I have often said: if a ruler wishes to honor maternal kin, enfeoff them in frontier states, enrich their stipends, and limit their power so that the throne shows no partial favor and the realm no private suspicion.
units.literal: Your servant often says: if a ruler of the age wishes to honor the maternal clan, why not enfeoff them with frontier states, enrich their stipends and gifts, and limit their power and advantage, so that above there is no partial favor and below no private talk.

units.zh: 如此，榮辱何從而生！
units.en: Then whence would honor or disgrace arise!
units.literal: Thus, from what would honor and disgrace arise!

units.zh: 噂𠴲何辭而起！
units.en: Whence would slander spring!
units.literal: From what words would slander and calumny spring!

units.zh: 往者惟亮一人，宿有名望，尚致世變，況今居之者素無聞焉！
units.en: Formerly Yu Liang alone, though long renowned, still brought turmoil; how much more those who hold power today and were never heard of before!
units.literal: Formerly there was only Yu Liang alone, long with a name of standing, yet still he brought change to the age; how much more those who hold the posts today, who from the first had no renown!

units.zh: 且人情易惑，難以戶告，縱今陛下無私于彼，天下之人誰謂不私乎！
units.en: Human feelings are easily swayed and cannot be told house to house; even if Your Majesty is impartial, who in the realm will believe it!
units.literal: Moreover human feelings are easily confused and hard to tell door to door; even if Your Majesty today has no partiality toward them, who in the realm would say there is none!

units.zh: 臣與冰等名位殊班，出處懸邈，又國之戚昵，理應降悅，以適事會。
units.en: Bing and I differ in rank and station, yet as kin of the state I ought by rights to yield and rejoice at the occasion.
units.literal: Your servant and Bing and the others differ in rank and name, are far apart in origin and position, and moreover are kin of the state; by reason one ought to yield and rejoice to suit the occasion.

units.zh: 臣獨矯抗此言者，上為陛下，退為冰計，疾苟容之臣，坐鑒得失。
units.en: I speak against the tide alone: for Your Majesty above and for Bing's sake below, hating ministers who only flatter and judging gain and loss plainly.
units.literal: Your servant alone presses this contrary speech: for Your Majesty above, for Bing's sake below; despising ministers who only accommodate; sitting in judgment of gain and loss.

units.zh: 顛而不扶，焉用彼相！
units.en: If one does not right what is overturned, of what use is that minister!
units.literal: If one does not right what is overturned, what use is that minister!

units.zh: 昔徐福陳霍氏之戒，宣帝不從，至令忠臣更為逆族，良由察之不審，防之無漸。
units.en: Formerly Xu Fu warned against the Huo clan; Emperor Xuan did not heed him, and loyal ministers became a traitorous house because he did not examine carefully or guard against gradual encroachment.
units.literal: Formerly Xu Fu set forth the warning of the Huo clan; Emperor Xuan did not follow it, so that even loyal ministers became a rebellious lineage, truly because investigation was not careful and prevention had no gradual steps.

units.zh: 臣今所陳，可謂防漸矣。
units.en: What I now set forth is prevention at the first sign.
units.literal: What your servant now sets forth may be called prevention at the first sign.

units.zh: 但恐陛下不明臣之忠，不用臣之計，事過之日，更處焦爛之後耳。
units.en: I fear only that Your Majesty may not see my loyalty or use my plan, and that after disaster passes you will again stand amid the ashes.
units.literal: Only fearing that Your Majesty may not understand your servant's loyalty and may not use your servant's plan; after the affair has passed, one will again be in the charred wreckage.

units.zh: 昔王章、劉向每上封事，未嘗不指斥王氏，故令二子或死或刑。
units.en: Formerly Wang Zhang and Liu Xiang denounced the Wang clan in every sealed memorial and ended dead or punished.
units.literal: Formerly Wang Zhang and Liu Xiang, each time they submitted sealed memorials, never failed to denounce the Wang clan, so both men ended dead or under punishment.

units.zh: 谷永、張禹依違不對，故容身苟免，取譏於世。
units.en: Gu Yong and Zhang Yu equivocated and preserved themselves, winning only the age's ridicule.
units.literal: Gu Yong and Zhang Yu equivocated and did not answer directly, so they preserved themselves and escaped, drawing ridicule from the age.

units.zh: 臣被髮殊俗，位為上將，夙夜惟憂，罔知所報，惟當外殄寇仇，內盡忠規，陳力輸誠，以答國恩。
units.en: I wear disheveled hair in a foreign land, hold supreme command, worry day and night how to repay the state, and can only destroy enemies abroad and offer loyal remonstrance within.
units.literal: Your servant wears disheveled hair in a foreign land, holds the rank of supreme general, worries day and night and knows not how to repay, and can only destroy enemies abroad, exhaust loyal remonstrance within, exert strength and offer sincerity to answer the state's grace.

units.zh: 臣若不言，誰當言者！
units.en: If I do not speak, who will!
units.literal: If your servant does not speak, who will speak!

units.zh: 又與冰書曰：君以椒房之親，舅氏之昵，總據樞機，出內王命，兼擁列將州司之位，昆弟網羅，顯布畿甸。
units.en: He also wrote to Yu Bing: By empress kinship and maternal closeness you hold the pivot, issue and receive royal commands, and with your brothers hold command and provincial posts, your network displayed across the capital region.
units.literal: Again he wrote to Bing, saying: You, by the intimacy of the empress's chamber and closeness as maternal kin, hold the pivot in total, issue and receive royal commands, and together hold the posts of column commanders and provincial overseers; your brothers spread a net, displayed across the capital region.

units.zh: 自秦、漢以來，隆赫之極，豈有若此者乎！
units.en: Since Qin and Han, has splendor reached such a height!
units.literal: Since Qin and Han, has there been such extreme splendor!

units.zh: 以吾觀之，若功就事舉，必享申伯之名；
units.en: In my view, if your work succeeds you will enjoy Shen Bo's fame;
units.literal: In my view, if merit is achieved and affairs succeed, you will surely enjoy the name of Shen Bo;

units.zh: 如或不立，將不免梁竇之跡矣。
units.en: if not, you will not escape the fate of Liang Ji and Dou Xian.
units.literal: If not, you will not escape the track of Liang Ji and Dou Xian.

units.zh: 每睹史傳，未嘗不寵恣母族，使執權亂朝，先有殊世之榮，尋有負乘之累，所謂愛之適足以為害。
units.en: History shows that rulers who pamper the maternal clan and let them rule always win brief glory and then the ruin of "love becomes harm."
units.literal: Each time I read the histories, rulers never fail to pamper and indulge the maternal clan, letting them hold power and disorder the court; first they have glory beyond the age, then the burden of riding when unfit, the saying that love rightly becomes harm.

units.zh: 吾常忿歷代之主，不盡防萌終寵之術，何不業以一土之封，令籓國相承，如周之齊、陳？
units.en: I resent that successive rulers never fully guarded against early favor; why not grant a single fief and let frontier states succeed one another, as Qi and Chen of Zhou?
units.literal: I often resent that rulers of successive ages did not fully use the art of preventing the first sprout and ending favor; why not grant a single fief and let frontier states succeed one another, as Qi and Chen of Zhou?

units.zh: 如此則永保南面之尊，復何黜辱之憂乎！
units.en: Then they would forever preserve honor facing south, with no fear of dismissal or disgrace!
units.literal: Then they would forever preserve the honor of facing south; what worry of dismissal and disgrace!

units.zh: 竇武、何進好善虛己。
units.en: Dou Wu and He Jin loved goodness and humbled themselves.
units.literal: Dou Wu and He Jin loved goodness and emptied themselves.

units.zh: 賢士歸心，雖為閹豎所危，天下嗟痛，猶有能履以不驕，圖國亡身故也。
units.en: Worthy men rallied to them; though eunuchs endangered them and the realm mourned, they could still walk without pride and gave their lives for the state.
units.literal: Worthy men gave them their hearts; though endangered by eunuch minions and mourned by the realm, they could still walk without pride and plotted for the state even at the cost of their lives.

units.zh: 方今四海有倒懸之急，中夏逋僭逆之寇，家有漉血之怨，人有復仇之憾，甯得安枕逍遙，雅談卒歲邪！
units.en: Now the realm hangs inverted, rebels roam China, families bear blood-soaked grievances and men thirst for vengeance; how can one rest at ease and talk elegantly through the year!
units.literal: Now the four seas have the urgency of the inverted hanging; within China flee usurping rebels; families bear blood-soaked grievances and men the regret of vengeance; how can one rest on pillows at ease, discoursing elegantly through the year!

units.zh: 吾雖寡德，過蒙先帝列將之授，以數郡之人，尚欲併吞強虜，是以自頃迄今，交鋒接刃，一時務農，三時用武，而猶師徒不頓，倉有餘粟，敵人日畏，我境日廣，況乃王者之威，堂堂之勢，豈可同年而語哉！
units.en: I am little in virtue, yet the former emperor made me a column commander; with several commanderies I still mean to swallow strong foes. From lately until now I farm one season and fight three, yet my armies do not fail, my granaries hold surplus, the enemy daily fears us and our borders widen daily; how much more the majesty of a king and stately power, how can these be compared!
units.literal: Though I am few in virtue, I have unduly received the former emperor's grant of command over the columns; with the people of several commanderies I still wish to swallow strong enemies; therefore from recently until now, clashing blades and meeting swords, one season for farming and three for war, yet the army is not exhausted, the granaries have surplus grain, the enemy daily fears us and our borders daily widen; how much more the king's majesty and stately power, how can they be spoken of in the same year!

units.zh: 冰見表及書甚懼，以其絕遠，非所能制，遂與何充等奏聽皝稱燕王。
units.en: Yu Bing, terrified yet unable to coerce him from afar, joined He Chong in recommending that the court recognize the title of king of Yan.
units.literal: Bing seeing the memorial and letter was greatly afraid; because they were extremely distant, not what they could control; thereupon with He Chong and others memorialized to permit Huang to style King of Yan.

units.zh: 其年皝伐高句麗，王釗乞盟而還。
units.en: That year he invaded Goguryeo; King Gao Zhen sued for peace and he withdrew.
units.literal: That year Huang campaigned against Gaogouli; King Gao Zhen begged alliance and returned.

units.zh: 明年，釗遣其世子朝於皝。
units.en: The next year Gao Zhen sent his heir to pay homage to Huang.
units.literal: The next year, Zhen sent his heir apparent to court at Huang.

units.zh: 初，段遼之敗也，建威翰奔于宇文歸，自以威名夙振，終不保全，乃陽狂恣酒，被髮歌呼。
units.en: After Duan Liao’s fall Murong Han fled to Yuwen Gui, reckoned his fame would never let him live, and feigned madness—drinking, singing, and disheveled hair.
units.literal: In the beginning, when Duan Liao was defeated, Jianwei Han fled to Yuwen Gui; himself thought his awe-inspiring name long had shaken others, in the end could not preserve whole; thereupon feigned madness, wantonly drank, let hair down and sang and shouted.

units.zh: 歸信而不禁，故得周遊自任，至於山川形便，攻戰要路，莫不練之。
units.en: Yuwen Gui trusted the act and left him free, so Han mapped every defile and road.
units.literal: Gui believed and did not restrain; therefore was able to roam at will, reaching mountains and rivers’ forms and conveniences, attack and battle crucial roads—none not practiced.

units.zh: 皝遣商人王車陰使察翰，翰見車無言，撫膺而已。
units.en: Huang sent the trader Wang Che to spy; Murong Han met him in silence, only clutching his chest.
units.literal: Huang sent merchant Wang Che secretly to observe Han; Han seeing Che spoke nothing, stroked his breast only.

units.zh: 車還以白，皝曰：「翰欲來也。」
units.en: Wang Che reported the sign; Huang said, “He wants to come home.”
units.literal: Che returned and reported; Huang said: “Han wishes to come.”

units.zh: 乃遣車遺翰弓矢，翰乃竊歸駿馬，攜其二子而還。
units.en: He sent Wang Che with a bow and arrows; Murong Han stole horses and rode back with his two sons.
units.literal: Thereupon sent Che to present Han bow and arrows; Han then stole fine horses, carried his two sons and returned.

units.zh: 皝將圖石氏，從容謂諸將曰：「石季龍自以安樂諸城守防嚴重，城之南北必不設備，今若詭路出其不意，冀之北土盡可破也。」
units.en: Planning against the Shi, he told his commanders, “Shi Hu trusts his garrisons at Anle and neglects the open country north and south of the wall—a sudden raid could overrun the whole Ji plain.”
units.literal: Huang was about to plan the Shi clan; leisurely said to the generals: “Shi Jilong thinks the cities of Anle and the rest guard defense strict and heavy; surely north and south of the city he does not set equipment; now if by deceitful route go out where he does not expect, the whole north of Ji can be broken.”

units.zh: 於是率騎二萬出蠮螉塞，長驅至於薊城，進渡武遂津，入于高陽，所過焚燒積聚，掠徙幽、冀三萬餘戶。
units.en: He led twenty thousand horse through Wengong Pass, raced to Ji, crossed Wusui Ford into Gaoyang, burned depots, and carried off thirty thousand households from You and Ji.
units.literal: Thereupon led cavalry twenty thousand out Wengong Pass, long drove reaching Ji city, advanced crossed Wusui Ford, entered Gaoyang; wherever passed burned granaries, plundered and moved You and Ji over thirty thousand households.

units.zh: 使陽裕、唐柱等築龍城，構宮廟，改柳城為龍城縣。
units.en: He had Yang Yu and Tang Zhu build Longcheng, raised palaces and shrines, and renamed Liucheng county Longcheng.
units.literal: Had Yang Yu, Tang Zhu, and others build Longcheng, construct palace and temples, changed Liucheng to Longcheng county.

units.zh: 於是成帝使兼大鴻臚郭希持節拜皝侍中、大都督河北諸軍事、大將軍、燕王，其餘官皆如故。
units.en: Emperor Cheng then sent Guo Xi to invest him as palace attendant, grand commander north of the river, grand general, and king of Yan, leaving other posts unchanged.
units.literal: Thereupon Emperor Cheng sent concurrent Grand Herald Guo Xi bearing credentials to appoint Huang Palace Attendant, Grand Commander of all military affairs north of the Yellow River, Grand General, King of Yan; the rest of offices all as before.

units.zh: 封諸功臣百餘人，
units.en: He enfeoffed more than a hundred deserving officers.
units.literal: Enfeoffed the various meritorious ministers over a hundred persons.

units.zh: 咸康七年，皝遷都龍城。
units.en: In the seventh year of Xiankang, he moved his capital to Longcheng.
units.literal: In the seventh year of Xiankang, Huang moved the capital to Longcheng.

units.zh: 率勁卒四萬，入自南陝，以伐宇文、高句麗，又使翰及子垂為前鋒，遣長史王寓等勒眾萬五千，從北置而進。
units.en: He took forty thousand veterans through the southern defile against Yuwen and Goguryeo, with Murong Han and Murong Chui as van while Wang Yu led fifteen thousand from Beizhi.
units.literal: Led picked soldiers forty thousand, entered from the southern defile to campaign against Yuwen and Goguryeo; again had Han and son Chui as vanguard, sent chief clerk Wang Yu and others leading host fifteen thousand to advance from Beizhi.

units.zh: 高句麗王釗謂皝軍之從北路也，乃遣其弟武統精銳五萬距北置，躬率弱卒以防南陝。
units.en: King Gao Zhen assumed the main thrust would come from the north, sent fifty thousand under his brother Wu to Beizhi, and held the southern defile with weaker troops.
units.literal: Goguryeo King Zhen thought Huang’s army came by the northern route; thereupon sent his younger brother Wu leading picked fifty thousand to block Beizhi; personally led weak soldiers to guard the southern defile.

units.zh: 翰與釗戰於木底，大敗之，乘勝遂入丸都，釗單馬而遁。
units.en: Murong Han routed him at Mudi, pressed into Wandu, and Zhen fled alone on horseback.
units.literal: Han fought Zhen at Mudi, greatly defeated them, rode victory then entered Wandu; Zhen single horse fled.

units.zh: 皝掘釗父利墓，載其屍並其母妻珍寶，掠男女五萬餘口，焚其宮室，毀丸都而歸。
units.en: Huang opened Gao Zhen’s father Li’s tomb, carried off the corpse together with Zhen’s mother, wife, and treasures, plundered more than fifty thousand men and women, fired the palaces, and razed Wandu.
units.literal: Huang dug Zhen’s father Li’s tomb, loaded his corpse together with his mother, wife, and treasures, plundered over fifty thousand male and female, burned his palace chambers, destroyed Wandu and returned.

units.zh: 明年，釗遣使稱臣于皝，貢其方物，乃歸其父屍。
units.en: The next year Gao Zhen sent envoys declaring himself a subject of Huang, offered local products, and Huang then returned his father’s corpse.
units.literal: The next year, Zhen sent envoys declaring subject to Huang, offered their local products, then returned his father’s corpse.

units.zh: 宇文歸遣其國相莫淺渾伐皝，諸將請戰，皝不許。
units.en: Yuwen Gui sent Moqian Hun; Huang’s generals begged to fight but he refused.
units.literal: Yuwen Gui sent his state chancellor Moqian Hun to campaign against Huang; the generals requested battle; Huang did not permit.

units.zh: 渾以皝為憚之，荒酒縱獵，不復設備。
units.en: Moqian Hun assumed Huang was afraid and gave himself to drink and hunting without precautions.
units.literal: Hun because Huang feared them, indulged wine and wantonly hunted, again did not set defenses.

units.zh: 皝曰：「渾奢忌已甚，今則可一戰矣。」
units.en: Huang said, “Moqian Hun’s arrogance has peaked—now we can strike.”
units.literal: Huang said: “Hun’s extravagance and jealousy are already extreme; now then can one battle.”

units.zh: 遣翰率騎擊之，渾大敗，僅以身免，盡俘其眾。
units.en: Murong Han shattered his army and took nearly every man alive.
units.literal: Sent Han leading cavalry to strike them; Hun was greatly defeated, barely himself escaped, wholly captured their host.

units.zh: 皝躬巡郡縣，勸課農桑，起龍城宮闕。
units.en: Murong Huang toured his domains, pushed farming and sericulture, and raised palaces at Longcheng.
units.literal: Huang personally toured prefectures and counties, urged and supervised farming and sericulture, raised Longcheng palace and towers.

units.zh: 尋又率騎二萬親伐宇文歸，以翰及垂為前鋒。
units.en: He soon took twenty thousand horse against Yuwen Gui, with Murong Han and Murong Chui as van.
units.literal: Soon again led cavalry twenty thousand personally to campaign against Yuwen Gui, with Han and Chui as vanguard.

units.zh: 歸使其騎將涉奕於盡眾距翰，皝馳遣謂翰曰：「奕於雄悍，宜小避之，待虜勢驕，然後取也。」
units.en: Yuwen Gui sent Sheyiyu to hold Murong Han; Huang sent word: “Sheyiyu is fierce—spar lightly until he grows reckless, then strike.”
units.literal: Gui made his cavalry general Sheyiyu exhaust the host to resist Han; Huang gallop-sent word telling Han: “Sheyiyu is fierce and bold; ought slightly to avoid him, wait until the bandits’ situation grows arrogant, then take them.”

units.zh: 翰曰：「歸之精銳，盡在於此，今若克之，則歸可不勞兵而滅。
units.en: Murong Han replied, “Yuwen Gui’s best troops are here; crush them and his realm falls without a long campaign.
units.literal: Han said: “Gui’s picked troops are all here; now if we defeat them, then Gui can be destroyed without tiring the army.

units.zh: 奕于徒有虛名，其實易與耳，不宜縱敵挫吾兵氣。」
units.en: Sheyiyu is overrated and brittle—we must not let him sap our morale.”
units.literal: Sheyiyu vainly has empty name; in truth he is easy to deal with; ought not to loose the enemy and blunt our army’s spirit.”

units.zh: 於是前戰，斬奕於，盡俘其眾，歸遠遁漠北。
units.en: He attacked, slew Sheyiyu, took his army, and drove Yuwen Gui deep into the steppe.
units.literal: Thereupon advanced battle, beheaded Sheyiyu, wholly captured their host; Gui fled far to the northern desert.

units.zh: 皝開地千餘里，徙其部人五萬餘落于昌黎，改涉奕於城為威德城。
units.en: He annexed a thousand li of pasture, resettled fifty thousand Yuwen dependents at Changli, and renamed Sheyiyu’s fort Weide.
units.literal: Huang opened territory over a thousand li, moved their division people over fifty thousand settlements to Changli, changed Sheyiyu city to Weide city.

units.zh: 行飲至之禮，論功行賞各有差。
units.en: He held a victory feast and handed out graded rewards.
units.literal: Performed the “drink-on-arrival” rite, discussed merit and performed rewards each had gradations.

units.zh: 以牧牛給貧家，田于苑中，公收其八，二分入私。
units.en: Poor households received draft oxen to till the royal park on an eighty-twenty revenue split with the state.
units.literal: Used herding oxen given to poor families, fields in the royal park, the public took eight-tenths, two-tenths went private.

units.zh: 有牛而無地者，亦田苑中，公收其七，三分入私。
units.en: Householders who owned cattle but no land tilled the park on a seventy-thirty split.
units.literal: Those with oxen but without land, also fielded in the park, the public took seven-tenths, three-tenths went private.

units.zh: 皝記室參軍封裕諫曰：臣聞聖王之宰國也，薄賦而藏于百姓，分之以三等之田，十一而稅之；
units.en: Murong Huang's secretary Feng Yu remonstrated: I have heard that a sage king keeps taxes light and stores wealth among the people, divides land into three grades, and levies one part in ten;
units.literal: Murong Huang's secretary-advisor Feng Yu remonstrated, saying: Your servant has heard that when a sage king governs a state, he keeps taxes light and stores wealth among the people, divides land into three grades, and levies one part in ten;

units.zh: 寒者衣之，饑者食之，使家給人足。
units.en: he clothes the cold and feeds the hungry until every household is provided for.
units.literal: He clothes the cold and feeds the hungry, so that every household is provided for and every person has enough.

units.zh: 雖水旱而不為災者，何也？
units.en: Why then are flood and drought not disaster?
units.literal: Though there be flood or drought, why is it not disaster?

units.zh: 高選農官，務盡勸課，人治周田百畝，亦不假牛力；
units.en: Because high agricultural officers are chosen and encouragement enforced, each man tends a full hundred mu without borrowing oxen;
units.literal: Select agricultural officers with care, strive to the utmost in encouragement and assessment; each man tends a full hundred mu of field and does not borrow ox power;

units.zh: 力田者受旌顯之賞，惰農者有不齒之罰。
units.en: those who labor receive honors and the idle are punished.
units.literal: Those who labor in the fields receive banners of distinction, while idle farmers suffer the penalty of being unranked.

units.zh: 又量事置官，量官置人，使官必稱須，人不虛位，度歲入多少，裁而祿之。
units.en: Offices are matched to need, men do not hold empty posts, and salaries are trimmed to yearly revenue.
units.literal: Again measure affairs to establish offices, measure offices to appoint men, so that offices match need and men do not hold empty posts; estimate yearly revenue and trim salaries accordingly.

units.zh: 供百僚之外，藏之太倉，三年之耕，餘一年之粟。
units.en: Beyond supplying officials, grain is stored in the Great Granary until three years' plowing leaves one year's surplus.
units.literal: Beyond supplying the hundred officials, store in the Great Granary; three years' plowing leaves one year's grain surplus.

units.zh: 以斯而積，公用于何不足？
units.en: Stored thus, how could public use fail?
units.literal: Accumulated thus, how could public use be insufficient?

units.zh: 水旱其如百姓何！
units.en: Flood and drought, what can they do to the people!
units.literal: Flood and drought, what can they do to the people!

units.zh: 雖務農之令屢發，二千石令長莫有志勤在公、銳盡地利者。
units.en: Yet though farming orders issue repeatedly, no magistrate or two-thousand-bushel official works the land with public zeal.
units.literal: Though orders to promote agriculture are repeatedly issued, among the two-thousand-bushel administrators and magistrates none are intent on public diligence or keen to exhaust the land's advantage.

units.zh: 故漢祖知其如此，以墾田不實，征殺二千石以十數，是以明、章之際，號次升平。
units.en: Knowing this, Han's founder executed more than ten such officials for false land reports, and under Ming and Zhang the age was nearly peaceful.
units.literal: Therefore Han's founder, knowing this, executed more than ten such officials for false reports of reclaimed fields, and in the Ming and Zhang era the age was called nearly peaceful.

units.zh: 自永嘉喪亂，百姓流亡，中原蕭條，千里無煙，饑寒流隕，相繼溝壑。
units.en: Since the Yongjia calamity the people have fled; the central plain is desolate and hunger fills the ditches.
units.literal: Since the Yongjia calamity the people have fled; the central plain is desolate, for a thousand li no smoke rises; hunger and cold flow in ruin and men fall one after another into ditches and gullies.

units.zh: 先王以神武聖略，保全一方，威以殄奸，德以懷遠，故九州之人，塞表殊類，繈負萬里，若赤子之歸慈父，流人之多舊土十倍有餘，人殷地狹，故無田者十有四焉。
units.en: Murong Hui, by divine martial strategy, preserved this region, destroyed traitors by might and won the distant by virtue; people of the nine provinces and foreign tribes came carrying infants for ten thousand li like children to a loving father. Refugees outnumbered the old population more than tenfold; land was scarce and fourteen in ten had no fields.
units.literal: The former king, by divine martial sage strategy, preserved one region; by might he destroyed traitors and by virtue he won the distant; therefore people of the nine provinces and foreign tribes beyond the frontier came carrying infants for ten thousand li, like infants returning to a loving father; the displaced exceeded the old population more than tenfold, the people were many and the land narrow, so those without fields were fourteen in ten.

units.zh: 殿下以英聖之資，克廣先業，南摧強趙，東滅句麗，開境三千，戶增十萬，繼武闡廣之功，有高西伯。
units.en: Your Highness, with heroic endowment, has extended the former enterprise: south you crushed strong Zhao, east you destroyed Goguryeo, opened three thousand li and added a hundred thousand households, rivaling the great Earl of the West.
units.literal: Your Highness, with heroic and sage endowment, has been able to extend the former enterprise: south you crushed strong Zhao, east you destroyed Goguryeo, opened three thousand li of border and increased households by a hundred thousand, continuing the merit of martial expansion, rivaling the great Earl of the West.

units.zh: 宜省罷諸苑，以業流人。
units.en: Reduce the royal parks and settle refugees on the land.
units.literal: It is fitting to reduce and abolish the parks and estates and settle the displaced on them.

units.zh: 人至而無資產者，賜之以牧牛。
units.en: Grant cattle to those who arrive without property.
units.literal: Those who arrive without property should be granted cattle to herd.

units.zh: 人既殿下之人，牛豈失乎！
units.en: If the people are yours, how could the cattle be lost!
units.literal: If the people are Your Highness's people, how could the cattle be lost!

units.zh: 善藏者藏于百姓，若斯而已矣。
units.en: True storage is storage among the people; that is all.
units.literal: Those who store well store among the people; that is all.

units.zh: 邇者深副樂土之望，中國之人皆將壺餐奉迎，石季龍誰與居乎！
units.en: Recently you have deeply fulfilled the hope of a happy land; the people of China will all bring food to welcome you. Who then will remain with Shi Hu?
units.literal: Recently you have deeply fulfilled the hope of a happy land; the people of China will all bring food to welcome you; with Shi Hu, who can compare!

units.zh: 且魏、晉雖道消之世，猶削百姓不至於七八，持官牛田者官得六分，百姓得四分，私牛而官田者與官中分，百姓安之，人皆悅樂。
units.en: Even Wei and Jin, though the Way faded, did not reduce the people below seven or eight tenths; official-ox farmers gave six parts to the state and four to the people, private-ox farmers split evenly, and all rejoiced.
units.literal: Even Wei and Jin, though an age of fading Way, still did not reduce the people below seven or eight tenths; those who farmed with official oxen gave six parts to the state and four to the people; those with private oxen on official land split evenly with the state; the people were secure and all rejoiced.

units.zh: 臣猶曰非明王之道，而況增乎！
units.en: I still say this is not the way of a clear king, and how much more if burdens increase!
units.literal: Your servant still says this is not the way of a clear king, and how much more if it is increased!

units.zh: 且水旱之厄，堯、湯所不免，王者宜浚治溝澮，循鄭白、西門、史起溉灌之法，旱則決溝為雨，水則入於溝瀆，上無《雲漢》之憂，下無昏墊之患。
units.en: Flood and drought, which Yao and Tang did not escape, require dredged canals and irrigation like Zheng Bai, Ximen, and Shi Qi; drought is eased by channels and flood by drainage, ending worry above and mire below.
units.literal: Moreover flood and drought are misfortunes Yao and Tang did not escape; a king ought to dredge and maintain canals and ditches, follow the irrigation methods of Zheng Bai, Ximen, and Shi Qi; in drought open ditches as rain, in flood send water into channels; above no worry like the "Cloudy Han," below no trouble of mire and flood.

units.zh: 句麗、百濟及宇文、段部之人，皆兵勢所徙，非如中國慕義而至，咸有思歸之心。
units.en: Goguryeo, Baekje, Yuwen, and Duan peoples were moved by force, not like Chinese who came admiring righteousness; all long to return home.
units.literal: The people of Goguryeo, Baekje, and the Yuwen and Duan tribes were all moved by military force, not like those of China who came admiring righteousness; all have hearts that long to return.

units.zh: 今戶垂十萬，狹湊都城，恐方將為國家深害，宜分其兄弟宗屬，徙于西境諸城，撫之以恩，檢之以法，使不得散在居人，知國之虛實。
units.en: With households nearing a hundred thousand crowded against the capital, divide their kindred and move them to western border cities, ruling them with kindness and law so they do not learn the state's strength and weakness.
units.literal: Now households approach a hundred thousand, crowded narrow against the capital; I fear this will soon become a deep harm to the state; it is fitting to divide their brothers and lineage and move them to western border cities, soothe them with kindness and inspect them with law, so they do not scatter among settled people and learn the state's strength and weakness.

units.zh: 今中原未平，資畜宜廣，官司猥多，遊食不少，一夫不耕，歲受其饑。
units.en: The central plain is not pacified and stores must grow, yet offices multiply and idlers abound; one man who does not plow makes the year hungrier.
units.literal: Now the central plain is not yet pacified and stores ought to be enlarged; official posts are numerous and idlers not few; one man who does not plow, the year receives his hunger.

units.zh: 必取於耕者而食之，一人食一人之力，游食數萬，損亦如之，安可以家給人足，治致升平！
units.en: Food taken from plowmen feeds idlers; tens of thousands eat without plowing, and the loss is the same; how can every household be provided for and the realm governed to peace!
units.literal: Food must be taken from those who plow to feed others; one man eating the strength of one man, with tens of thousands idling, the loss is likewise; how can one achieve provision for every household and govern to peaceful ascendancy!

units.zh: 殿下降覽古今之事多矣，政之巨患莫甚於斯。
units.en: Your Highness has read past and present; no governmental evil exceeds this.
units.literal: Your Highness has read many affairs of past and present; no great evil of government exceeds this.

units.zh: 其有經略出世，才稱時求者，自可隨須置之列位。
units.en: Men of world-ranging talent may be placed as needed.
units.literal: Those with world-ranging strategy and talent suited to the age's needs may be placed in posts as needed.

units.zh: 非此已往，其耕而食，蠶而衣，亦天之道也。
units.en: Beyond this, plow to eat and raise silkworms to clothe, as heaven ordains.
units.literal: Beyond this, to plow and eat, to raise silkworms and clothe, is also heaven's way.

units.zh: 殿下聖性寬明，思言若渴，故人盡芻蕘，有犯無隱。
units.en: Your Highness is broad and clear, thirsting for counsel; men speak even humble truths without hiding.
units.literal: Your Highness is sage in nature, broad and clear, thirsting for words as for water; therefore men exhaust even firewood and grass, offending yet not hiding.

units.zh: 前者參軍王憲、大夫劉明並竭忠獻款，以貢至言，雖頗有逆鱗，意在無責。
units.en: Staff officer Wang Xian and Grand Master Liu Ming spoke with full loyalty; though they ruffled scales, they meant no offense.
units.literal: Formerly the staff officer Wang Xian and Grand Master Liu Ming both exhausted loyalty and offered sincerity, presenting utmost words; though they somewhat ruffled scales, the intent was not to blame.

units.zh: 主者奏以妖言犯上，至之于法，殿下慈弘苞納，恕其大辟，猶削黜禁錮，不齒於朝。
units.en: Officials charged them with demonic speech; Your Highness pardoned their capital crime yet still barred them from court.
units.literal: The responsible officials memorialized that they spoke demonic words offending superiors and brought them to law; Your Highness, merciful and broad in acceptance, pardoned their capital offense yet still demoted, barred, and excluded them from court.

units.zh: 其言是也，殿下固宜納之；
units.en: If their words were right, you ought to accept them;
units.literal: If their words were right, Your Highness ought indeed to accept them;

units.zh: 如其非也，宜亮其狂狷。
units.en: if not, make allowance for blunt integrity.
units.literal: If not, you ought to make allowance for their blunt integrity.

units.zh: 罪諫臣而求直言，亦猶北行詣越，豈有得邪！
units.en: To punish remonstrating ministers while seeking straight words is like going north to reach Yue!
units.literal: To punish remonstrating ministers while seeking straight words is like going north to reach Yue; how can there be gain!

units.zh: 右長史宋該等阿媚苟容，輕劾諫士，己無骨鯁，嫉人有之，掩蔽耳目，不忠之甚。
units.en: Right chief clerk Song Gai and others flatter, impeach remonstrators lightly, have no backbone yet envy it in others, and cover eyes and ears, most disloyal.
units.literal: Right Chief Clerk Song Gai and others flatter and accommodate, lightly impeach remonstrators, themselves without backbone yet jealous when others have it, covering eyes and ears, most disloyal.

units.zh: 四業者國之所資，教學者有國盛事。
units.en: The four occupations sustain the state; teaching and learning are its great affair.
units.literal: The four occupations are what the state relies on; teaching and learning are the state's great affair.

units.zh: 習戰務農，尤其本也。
units.en: War training and agriculture are especially the root.
units.literal: Training for war and promoting agriculture are especially the root.

units.zh: 百工商賈，猶其末耳。
units.en: Merchants and craftsmen are the branch.
units.literal: Merchants and craftsmen are yet the branch.

units.zh: 宜量軍國所須，置其員數，已外歸之于農，教之戰法，學者三年無成，亦宜還之于農，不可徒充大員，以塞聰俊之路。
units.en: Measure army and state needs, set posts, return the rest to farming, teach battle methods, and send students who fail after three years back to the fields; do not fill posts vainly and block worthy men.
units.literal: It is fitting to measure what army and state require, set the number of posts, and return the rest to farming; teach them battle methods; students who after three years have no achievement should also return to farming; they must not vainly fill great posts and block the path of the keen and worthy.

units.zh: 臣之所言當也，願時速施行；
units.en: If I am right, enact this swiftly;
units.literal: If what your servant says is right, I wish it swiftly enacted;

units.zh: 非也，登加罪戮，使天下知朝廷從善如流，罰惡不淹。
units.en: if not, punish me, so the realm knows the court follows good like flowing water and punishes evil without delay.
units.literal: If not, add punishment and execution, so the realm knows the court follows good like flowing water and punishes evil without delay.

units.zh: 王憲、劉明，忠臣也，願宥忤鱗之愆，收其藥石之效。
units.en: Wang Xian and Liu Ming are loyal ministers; pardon their bluntness and gather the benefit of their medicine-stone counsel.
units.literal: Wang Xian and Liu Ming are loyal ministers; I wish their offense of ruffling scales pardoned and the effect of their medicine-stone counsel gathered.

units.zh: 皝乃令曰：「覽封記室之諫，孤實懼焉。
units.en: Huang issued an edict: “Feng Yu’s words frighten me.
units.literal: Huang thereupon ordered, saying: “Having read Secretary Feng’s remonstrance, I truly fear it.

units.zh: 君以黎元為國，黎元以穀為命。
units.en: The ruler exists for his people; the people live on grain.
units.literal: The lord takes the black-haired people as the state; the black-haired people take grain as life.

units.zh: 然則農者，國之本也，而二千石令長不遵孟春之令，惰農弗勸，宜以尤不修辟者措之刑法，肅厲屬城。
units.en: Agriculture is the foundation, yet magistrates ignore spring plowing—those who leave fields idle should face punishment to wake the commanderies.
units.literal: Then farming is the state’s root, yet two-thousand-bushel magistrates and county chiefs do not obey the first month’s orders, lazy farmers are not urged—ought with blame on those who do not cultivate wasteland apply to them criminal law, to awe and encourage dependent cities.

units.zh: 主者明詳推檢，具狀以聞。
units.en: Let bureaus audit every case and report in full.
units.literal: Let the responsible officials clearly examine and push investigation, submit full reports to be heard.

units.zh: 苑囿悉可罷之，以給百姓無田業者。
units.en: Close the hunting reserves and give that land to landless peasants.
units.literal: Hunting parks all can be abolished, to give to common people without fields or occupations.

units.zh: 貧者全無資產，不能自存，各賜牧牛一頭。
units.en: Give each destitute household a draft ox.
units.literal: Poor persons wholly lack assets, cannot preserve themselves—each grant one herding ox.

units.zh: 若私有餘力，樂取官牛墾官田者，其依魏、晉舊法。
units.en: Whoever wishes to rent state oxen and state land may do so under Wei–Jin precedent.
units.literal: If private surplus strength, happy to take official oxen to reclaim official fields, let it follow Wei and Jin old laws.

units.zh: 溝洫溉灌，有益官私，主者量造，務盡水陸之勢。
units.en: Dig irrigation works for public and private good—let engineers plan every channel.
units.literal: Ditches and channels irrigation pour, benefit public and private; let the responsible officials measure and build, exhaust the advantage of water and land.

units.zh: 中州未平，兵難不息，勳誠既多，官僚不可以減也。
units.en: The heartland is still at war, so I cannot yet cut official posts.
units.literal: The central plain is not yet pacified; military difficulty does not cease; merit and loyalty are already many—bureaucracy cannot be reduced.

units.zh: 待克平凶醜，徐更議之。
units.en: We will revisit staff cuts after victory.
units.literal: Wait until we crush the villains, slowly again deliberate it.

units.zh: 百工商賈數，四佐與列將速定大員，余者還農。
units.en: Cap tradesmen and aides to fixed quotas; everyone else goes back to the plow.
units.literal: Hundred crafts and merchants’ numbers, four assistants and column generals quickly fix great quotas; the rest return to farming.

units.zh: 學生不任訓教者，亦除員錄。
units.en: Strike idle students from the rolls.
units.literal: Students who do not bear training and teaching, also remove from rolls.

units.zh: 夫人臣關言於人主，至難也，妖妄不經之事皆應蕩然不問，擇其善者而從之。
units.en: Ministers who speak truth deserve patience—ignore wild rumors but heed good counsel.
units.literal: As for minister’s presenting words to the lord sovereign—most difficult; demonic and wild not-classic matters all ought to be swept away unasked; choose the good of them and follow them.

units.zh: 王憲、劉明雖其罪應禁黜，亦猶孤之無大量也。
units.en: Wang Xian and Liu Ming, although their offenses would warrant ban and dismissal, also show my own lack of forbearance.
units.literal: Wang Xian and Liu Ming although their crimes ought to be banned and dismissed, also is my lacking great measure.

units.zh: 可悉復本官，仍居諫司。
units.en: Restore censured advisers to their posts.
units.literal: Can all restore original offices, still dwell in remonstrance offices.

units.zh: 封生蹇蹇，深得王臣之體。
units.en: Feng Yu spoke as a true minister should.
units.literal: Feng Sheng staunchly upright, deeply attained the body of a royal minister.

units.zh: 《詩》不云乎：'無言不酬。
units.en: As the Odes says, “No good word goes unanswered.”
units.literal: The Odes does it not say: “No word without answer.”

units.zh: '其賜錢五萬，明宣內外，有欲陳孤過者，不拘貴賤，勿有所諱。」
units.en: Award him fifty thousand cash and invite anyone, high or low, to criticize me freely.”
units.literal: Grant cash fifty thousand; clearly proclaim inside and outside: whoever wishes to state my faults, not constrained noble or base, do not have what is taboo.”

units.zh: 時有黑龍、白龍各一，見於龍山，皝親率群僚觀之，去龍二百餘步，祭乙太宰。
units.en: A black dragon and a white dragon appeared on Long Mountain; Huang led his court within two hundred paces and offered the great sacrifice.
units.literal: At the time there were black dragon and white dragon each one, appeared at Long Mountain; Huang personally led the group of officials to observe them, two hundred-odd steps from the dragons, sacrificed with the grand boar offering.

units.zh: 二龍交首嬉翔，解角而去。
units.en: The beasts intertwined, sported in the air, dropped their horns, and flew away.
units.literal: The two dragons crossed heads, sported and soared, shed horns and departed.

units.zh: 皝大悅，還宮，赦其境內，號新宮曰和龍，立龍翔佛寺於山上。
units.en: Elated, he returned, proclaimed an amnesty, renamed the palace Helong, and built a Buddhist monastery on the height.
units.literal: Huang greatly pleased, returned palace, pardoned those within his borders, styled the new palace Helong, established Dragon-Soar Buddha temple on the mountain.

units.zh: 賜其大臣子弟為官學生者號高門生，立東庠于舊宮，以行鄉射之禮，每月臨觀，考試優劣。
units.en: He labeled elite students “high-gate pupils,” reopened the eastern school for archery rites, and each month examined their progress.
units.literal: Granted his great ministers’ sons and younger brothers who were official students the title “high-gate students,” set up the eastern school in the old palace, to perform the village archery rite, each month personally observing, examining excellence and inferiority.

units.zh: 皝雅好文籍，勤于講授，學徒甚盛，至千餘人。
units.en: He loved books, lectured tirelessly, and kept more than a thousand students.
units.literal: Huang by nature loved documents and records, diligent in lecturing and teaching; students were extremely many, reaching over a thousand persons.

units.zh: 親造《太上章》以代《急就》，又著《典誡》十五篇，以教胄子。
units.en: He wrote a primer to replace the Rush to Literacy and fifteen moral essays for the royal sons.
units.literal: Personally composed the “Supreme Lord Chapter” to replace the “Rush to Literacy,” also wrote fifteen pieces of “Classic Admonitions,” to teach the sons of the house.

units.zh: 慕容恪攻高句麗南蘇，克之，置戍而還。
units.en: Murong Ke seized Nansu from Goguryeo and left a garrison.
units.literal: Murong Ke attacked Goguryeo’s Nansu, took it, set garrison and returned.

units.zh: 三年，遣其世子俊與恪率騎萬七千東襲夫餘，克之，虜其王及部眾五萬餘口以還。
units.en: In his third regnal year he sent Murong Jun and Murong Ke with seventeen thousand horse against Puyu; they captured the king and fifty thousand subjects.
units.literal: In the third year, sent his heir apparent Jun with Ke leading cavalry seventeen thousand east to raid Puyu, took it, captured their king and division host over fifty thousand mouths and returned.

units.zh: 皝親臨東庠考試學生，其經通秀異者，擢充近侍。
units.en: He tested students at the eastern school and promoted the best as attendants.
units.literal: Huang personally arrived at the eastern school to examine students; those whose classics were thorough and outstanding, promoted to fill close attendance.

units.zh: 以久旱，丐百姓田租。
units.en: He remitted rent during a drought.
units.literal: Because of long drought, begged off common people’s field rent.

units.zh: 罷成周、冀陽、營丘等郡。
units.en: He abolished several empty commanderies such as Chengzhou, Jiyang, and Yingqiu.
units.literal: Abolished Chengzhou, Jiyang, Yingqiu, and other commanderies.

units.zh: 以勃海人為興集縣，河間人為寧集縣，廣平、魏郡人為興平縣，東萊、北海人為育黎縣，吳人為吳縣，悉隸燕國。
units.en: He grouped refugees from Bohai, Hejian, Guangping, Wei, Donglai, Beihai, and Wu into new counties under Yan.
units.literal: Made Bohai people Xingji county, Hejian people Ningji county, Guangping and Wei commandery people Xingping county, Donglai and Beihai people Yuli county, Wu people Wu county—all subordinate to the state of Yan.

units.zh: 皝嘗畋於西鄙，將濟河，見一父老，服硃衣，乘白馬，舉手麾皝曰：「此非獵所，王其還也。」
units.en: While hunting on the western frontier Murong Huang was about to cross a river when he saw an old man in cinnabar robes on a white horse, who waved him off and said, "This is not a place for hunting; Your Majesty should return."
units.literal: Huang once hunted on the western border, about to cross the River, saw an old man, dressed cinnabar robes, riding a white horse, raised hand and waved Huang, saying: “This is not a hunting place; the king ought to return.”

units.zh: 秘之不言，遂濟河，連日大獲。
units.en: He kept silent, crossed the river, and enjoyed great sport for days.
units.literal: He concealed it and did not speak, thereupon crossed the River, continuously days great catch.

units.zh: 後見白兔，馳射之，馬倒被傷，乃說所見。
units.en: Later he charged a white hare, was thrown and hurt, and told the omen.
units.literal: Later saw white hare, galloped and shot it; horse fell and he was injured, then narrated what he had seen.

units.zh: 輦而還宮，引俊屬以後事。
units.en: They carried him home; he briefed Murong Jun on the succession.
units.literal: Carried on litter returned palace, led Jun to entrust later affairs.

units.zh: 以永和四年死，在位十五年，時年五十二。
units.en: He died in Yonghe 4 (348 CE) after fifteen years on the throne, aged fifty-two.
units.literal: Died in the fourth year of Yonghe, fifteen years on the throne, age fifty-two sui.

units.zh: 俊僭號，追諡文明皇帝。
units.en: After Murong Jun took the throne he posthumously styled his father Emperor Wenming.
units.literal: When Jun illegitimately assumed imperial title, posthumously honored him as Emperor Wenming.

units.zh: 慕容翰
units.en: Murong Han (defector general).
units.literal: Murong Han.

units.zh: 慕容翰，字元邕，廆之庶長子也。
units.en: Murong Han, courtesy name Yuanyong, was Murong Hui’s eldest son by a concubine.
units.literal: Murong Han, courtesy name Yuanyong, was Hui’s eldest son by a concubine.

units.zh: 性雄豪，多權略，猿臂工射，膂力過人。
units.en: He was bold, cunning, a superb archer, and immensely strong.
units.literal: Nature heroic and bold, abundant in stratagem; ape arms skilled at shooting; physical strength surpassed others.

units.zh: 廆甚奇之，委以折沖之任。
units.en: Murong Hui prized him and gave him the hardest fighting assignments.
units.literal: Hui greatly wondered at him, entrusted him with the charge of breaking the enemy’s momentum.

units.zh: 行師征伐，所在有功，威聲大振，為遠近所憚。
units.en: Every campaign brought success; neighbors far and near feared him.
units.literal: When lines marched and campaigned, wherever he went had merit; awe-inspiring name greatly shook, feared by far and near.

units.zh: 作鎮遼東，高句麗不敢為寇。
units.en: While he held Liaodong, Goguryeo dared not raid.
units.literal: As garrison commander in Liaodong, Goguryeo did not dare make raids.

units.zh: 善撫接，愛儒學，自士大夫至於卒伍，莫不樂而從之。
units.en: He won men from gentry to ranks by kindness and a love of learning.
units.literal: Skilled at comforting and drawing near, loved classical learning; from grandees down to common soldiers, none did not joyfully follow him.

units.zh: 及奔段遼，深為遼所敬愛。
units.en: Duan Liao honored him after his defection.
units.literal: When he fled to Duan Liao, deeply was respected and loved by Liao.

units.zh: 柳城之敗，段蘭欲乘勝深入，翰慮成本國之害，詭說于蘭，蘭遂不進。
units.en: After the defeat at Liucheng, Duan Lan wanted to push on, but Murong Han feigned advice that spared Yan a deeper strike.
units.literal: At Liucheng’s defeat, Duan Lan wished to ride victory to penetrate deep; Han worried it would complete harm to his native state, deceitfully spoke to Lan; Lan then did not advance.

units.zh: 後石季龍征遼，皝親將三軍略令支以北，遼議欲追之，翰知皝躬自總戎，戰必克勝，乃謂遼曰：「今石氏向至，方對大故，不宜復以小小為事。
units.en: Later when Shi Hu campaigned against Duan Liao and Murong Huang personally led an army to raid north of Lingzhi, Duan Liao debated pursuit. Knowing Huang commanded in person and must win, Murong Han told Duan Liao, "Now the Shi are about to arrive and you face a great enemy; you should not again take up small matters.
units.literal: Later Shi Jilong campaigned against Liao; Huang personally led the three armies raiding north of Lingzhi; Liao debated wishing to pursue him; Han knew Huang personally commanded the army, battle must seize victory; thereupon said to Liao: “Now the Shi clan is about to arrive, just facing great enemy; ought not again to take small matters as affairs.

units.zh: 燕王自來，士馬精銳。
units.en: Murong Huang’s host is elite.
units.literal: The King of Yan has come in person; soldiers and horses are picked and sharp.

units.zh: 兵者凶器，戰有危慮，若其失利，何以南禦乎！」
units.en: War is peril—if you lose here, how will you hold the south?”
units.literal: Weapons are ill-omened tools; battle has perilous anxiety; if it misses advantage, how to defend the south!”

units.zh: 蘭怒曰：「吾前聽卿誑說，致成今患，不復入卿計中矣。」
units.en: Duan Lan snapped, “Your last ‘advice’ ruined me—I will not heed you again.”
units.literal: Lan angrily said: “Formerly I listened to your deceitful talk, caused to complete today’s disaster; I do not again enter your schemes.”

units.zh: 乃率眾追皝，蘭果大敗。
units.en: He chased Huang and was crushed.
units.literal: Thereupon led host to pursue Huang; Lan was indeed greatly defeated.

units.zh: 翰雖處仇國，因事立忠，皆此類也。
units.en: Even in exile Murong Han worked secretly for Yan’s good.
units.literal: Although Han dwelt in an enemy state, by events established loyalty—all was of this kind.

units.zh: 及遼奔走，翰又北投宇文歸。
units.en: When Duan Liao fled in defeat, Han again went north to Yuwen Gui.
units.literal: When Liao fled in defeat, Han again north threw himself to Yuwen Gui.

units.zh: 既而逃，歸乃遣勁騎百餘追之。
units.en: Yuwen Gui sent a hundred picked riders after him.
units.literal: Having then fled, Gui thereupon sent fierce cavalry over a hundred to pursue him.

units.zh: 翰遙謂追者曰：「吾既思戀而歸，理無反面。
units.en: He shouted to them, “I mean to go home—I will not turn back.
units.literal: Han from afar told the pursuers: “I already long to return; in principle there is no turning back.

units.zh: 吾之弓矢，汝曹足知，無為相逼，自取死也。
units.en: You know my archery—do not force a fight.
units.literal: My bow and arrows, you lot fully know; do not force each other, self-seeking death.

units.zh: 吾處汝國久，恨不殺汝。
units.en: I have lived among you too long—I should have killed you.
units.literal: I have dwelt in your state long; I regret not killing you.

units.zh: 汝可百步豎刀，吾射中者，汝便宜反；
units.en: Plant a blade at a hundred paces—if I ring it, withdraw;
units.literal: You can at a hundred paces set up a blade; if I shoot the center, you then conveniently turn back;

units.zh: 不中者，可來前也。」
units.en: if I miss, come on.”
units.literal: if not center, you may come forward.”

units.zh: 歸騎解刀豎之，翰一發便中刀鐶，追騎乃散。
units.en: They fixed a blade; his first arrow struck the ring and they broke off the chase.
units.literal: Gui’s riders undid a blade and set it up; Han one shot then hit the blade ring; pursuing riders then scattered.

units.zh: 既至，皝甚加恩禮，
units.en: Huang welcomed him with rich honors.
units.literal: Having arrived, Huang greatly added favor and ceremony.

units.zh: 建元二年，從皝討宇文歸，臨陣為流矢所中，臥病積時。
units.en: In the second year of Jianyuan, he joined the war on Yuwen Gui, took a stray shaft, and lay long ill.
units.literal: In the second year of Jianyuan, he followed Huang to campaign against Yuwen Gui; on the line of battle he was struck by a stray arrow; he lay ill a long time.

units.zh: 後疾漸愈，於其家中騎馬自試，或有人告翰私習騎，疑為非常。
units.en: When he tried riding at home, informers called it sedition.
units.literal: Later illness gradually improved; at his home mounted horse to test himself; someone reported Han privately practiced riding, suspected as unusual.

units.zh: 皝素忌之，遂賜死焉。
units.en: Huang, who had always feared him, sent him poison.
units.literal: Huang plain envied him; thereupon granted death.

units.zh: 翰臨死謂使者曰：「翰懷疑外奔，罪不容誅，不能以骸骨委賊庭，故歸罪有司。
units.en: Murong Han told the messenger, “I fled in fear and deserved death, yet I would not die in a foreign hall, so I came home to face judgment.
units.literal: Han nearing death told the envoy: “Han harbored suspicion and fled abroad; crime does not permit execution; could not cast bones in the bandit court; therefore returned guilt to the responsible officials.

units.zh: 天慈曲湣，不肆之市朝，今日之死，翰之生也。
units.en: The king spared me a public execution—this death is mercy.
units.literal: Heaven’s kindness bent pity, did not display me in the marketplace; today’s death is Han’s life.

units.zh: 但逆胡跨據神州，中原未靖，翰常克心自誓，志吞醜虜，上成先王遺旨，下謝山海之責。
units.en: Yet the Hu still hold the Central Plain; I had hoped to cleanse them for Murong Hui’s sake.
units.literal: But the rebellious Hu stride occupying the divine continent; the central plain is not yet quieted; Han constantly set heart to swear, intent to swallow the ugly bandits, above to complete the late king’s leftover command, below to apologize for the duty to mountains and seas.

units.zh: 不圖此心不遂，沒有餘恨，命也奈何！」
units.en: That hope dies with me—such is fate.”
units.literal: Did not expect this heart not to succeed; dying there is surplus regret—fate it—what to do!”

units.zh: 仰藥而死。
units.en: He drank the poison and died.
units.literal: Raised poison and died.

units.zh: 陽裕
units.en: Yang Yu.
units.literal: Yang Yu.
