units.zh: 陽裕，字士倫，右北平無終人也。
units.en: Yang Yu, courtesy name Shilun, came from Wuzhong in right Beiping.
units.literal: Yang Yu, courtesy name Shilun, was a man of Wuzhong in Right Beiping.

units.zh: 少孤，兄弟皆早亡，單煢獨立，雖宗族無能識者，惟叔父耽幼而奇之，曰：「此兒非惟吾門之標秀，乃佐時之良器也。」
units.en: Orphaned young, with brothers dead early, he stood alone; few in the clan knew him, but his uncle Dan marveled at him even in youth and said, "This child is not only our clan's outstanding ornament but an instrument to serve the age."
units.literal: In youth orphaned, brothers all died early, alone and solitary; although the lineage group none could recognize him, only uncle Dan in youth wondered at him, saying: “This child is not only our gate’s outstanding show, but an instrument to aid the age.”

units.zh: 刺史和演辟為主簿。
units.en: Governor He Yan made him chief clerk.
units.literal: The governor He Yan summoned him as chief clerk.

units.zh: 王浚領州，轉治中從事，忌而不能任。
units.en: Under Wang Jun he rose to administration aide but was distrusted.
units.literal: Wang Jun held the province, transferred to aide in the bureau of administration, envied yet could not employ him.

units.zh: 石勒既克薊城，問棗嵩曰：「幽州人士，誰最可者？」
units.en: After Shi Le took Jicheng he asked Zao Song, "Among the gentlemen of Youzhou, who is most worthy?"
units.literal: After Shi Le took Ji city, asked Zao Song, saying: “Youzhou gentlemen, who is most worthy?”

units.zh: 嵩曰：「燕國劉翰，德素長者。
units.en: Zao Song said, "Liu Han of Yan, whose virtue is that of a plain elder.
units.literal: Song said: “Yan state’s Liu Han, virtue is plain elder.

units.zh: 北平陽裕，幹事之才。」
units.en: Yang Yu of Beiping for administrative talent.”
units.literal: Beiping’s Yang Yu, talent for handling affairs.”

units.zh: 勒曰：「若如君言，王公何以不任？」
units.en: Shi Le asked, "If what you say is so, why did Prince Wang not employ him?"
units.literal: Le said: “If like your words, why did the prince duke not employ them?”

units.zh: 嵩曰：「王公由不能任，所以為明公擒也。」
units.en: Song answered, “Because he could not use them, you captured him.”
units.literal: Song said: “The prince duke because he could not employ them, therefore became the enlightened lord’s captive.”

units.zh: 勒方任之，裕乃微服潛遁。
units.en: Shi Le meant to employ Yang Yu, who fled in disguise.
units.literal: Le was about to employ him; Yu then disguised himself and slipped away.

units.zh: 時鮮卑單于段眷為晉驃騎大將軍、遼西公，雅好人物，虛心延裕。
units.en: Duan Juan, Xianbei chieftain and Jin general, sought him eagerly.
units.literal: At the time Xianbei Shanyu Duan Juan was Jin’s General of Agile Cavalry and Duke of Liaoxi; by nature he loved men of talent and humbly invited Yu.

units.zh: 裕謂友人成泮曰：「仲尼喜佛肸之召，以匏瓜自喻，伊尹亦稱何事非君，何使非民，聖賢尚如此，況吾曹乎！
units.en: Yang Yu told his friend Cheng Pan, "Confucius rejoiced at Bi Xi's summons and likened himself to a gourd; Yi Yin too said, 'What affair is not that of the lord? What people are not his subjects?' Even sages were thus, how much more we!
units.literal: Yu told friend Cheng Pan, saying: “Confucius rejoiced at Bi Xi’s summons, used the gourd as metaphor; Yi Yin also said what affair is not lord, what people not subjects—even sages were thus; how much more our sort!

units.zh: 眷今召我，豈徒然哉！」
units.en: Duan Juan’s summons is no empty gesture!”
units.literal: Juan now summons me—how could it be vain!”

units.zh: 泮曰：「今華夏分崩，九州幅裂，軌跡所及，易水而已。
units.en: Cheng Pan replied, “China is shattered; beyond the Yi River there is no refuge.
units.literal: Pan said: “Now Huaxia split and crumbling, the nine provinces in tatters, where tracks reach is only to the Yi River.

units.zh: 欲偃蹇考槃，以待大通者，俟河之清也。
units.en: To hide and wait for peace is to wait for the Yellow River to run clear.
units.literal: Desiring to recline and await the great penetration—waiting for the Yellow River to clear—is waiting for the river to clear.

units.zh: 人壽幾何？
units.en: How long is a life?
units.literal: Human life how much?

units.zh: 古人以為白駒之歎。
units.en: The ancients sighed at time’s white colt.
units.literal: The ancients took this as the white colt’s sigh.

units.zh: 少遊有雲，郡掾足以廕後，況國相乎！
units.en: Even a county post can bless one’s heirs—let alone chancellor.
units.literal: Shao You said, a commandery aide suffices to shade posterity—how much more a state chancellor!

units.zh: 卿追蹤伊、孔，抑亦知機其神也。」
units.en: You follow Confucius and Yi Yin—you know when Heaven calls.”
units.literal: You trace Yi and Kong, or also know the moment’s spirit.”

units.zh: 裕乃應之。
units.en: Yang Yu accepted Duan Juan’s offer.
units.literal: Yu thereupon answered him.

units.zh: 拜郎中令、中軍將軍，處上卿位。
units.en: He was named palace director and central army general, ranking among the highest ministers.
units.literal: Appointed Palace Director, Central Army General, occupying the upper minister’s seat.

units.zh: 曆事段氏五主，甚見尊重。
units.en: He served five successive Duan lords and won deep respect.
units.literal: Passed through serving the Duan house’s five lords, greatly was respected.

units.zh: 段遼與皝相攻，裕諫曰：「臣聞親仁善鄰，國之寶也。
units.en: When Duan Liao and Murong Huang clashed, Yang Yu urged, “A state’s greatest treasure is to cherish kindness and befriend one’s neighbors.
units.literal: Duan Liao and Huang attacked each other; Yu remonstrated, saying: “I have heard that cherishing benevolence and befriending neighbors is the state’s treasure.

units.zh: 慕容與國世為婚姻，且皝令德之主，不宜連兵構怨，凋殘百姓。
units.en: The Murong house and yours have intermarried for generations; Murong Huang is a man of virtue—you must not exhaust the people in vendetta.
units.literal: Murong and the state generation after generation are marriage; moreover Huang is a lord of ordered virtue; ought not join arms and build resentment, withering the common people.

units.zh: 臣恐禍害之興，將由於此。
units.en: I fear calamity will come of this feud.
units.literal: Your servant fears the rise of disaster and harm will stem from this.

units.zh: 願兩追前失，通款如初，使國家有太山之安，蒼生蒙息肩之惠。」
units.en: Let both sides forget old quarrels and restore peace so the realm stands firm as Taishan and the people can lay down their burdens.”
units.literal: Wish both pursue former faults, communicate sincerity as at the beginning, cause the state to have Mount Tai’s peace, the black-haired people to receive the favor of resting shoulders.”

units.zh: 遼不從。
units.en: Duan Liao refused.
units.literal: Liao did not follow.

units.zh: 出為燕郡太守。
units.en: He left court to become grand warden of Yan commandery.
units.literal: Went out as Yan commandery grand warden.

units.zh: 石季龍克令支，裕以郡降，拜北平太守，徵為尚書左丞。
units.en: When Shi Hu seized Lingzhi, Yang Yu surrendered his commandery, was named grand warden of Beiping, then recalled as left assistant in the secretariat.
units.literal: Shi Jilong took Lingzhi; Yu with the commandery surrendered; appointed Beiping grand warden; summoned as Left Assistant to the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 段遼之請迎于季龍也，裕以左丞領征東麻秋司馬。
units.en: When Duan Liao asked Shi Hu for an escort, Yang Yu served as chief clerk under Ma Qiu.
units.literal: At the time of Duan Liao’s request to welcome from Jilong, Yu as left assistant concurrently led Eastern Campaign Ma Qiu’s major.

units.zh: 秋敗，裕為軍人所執，將詣皝。
units.en: Ma Qiu’s defeat left Yang Yu a prisoner on his way to Murong Huang.
units.literal: When Qiu was defeated, Yu was seized by soldiers, was about to be brought to Huang.

units.zh: 皝素聞裕名，即命釋其囚，拜郎中令，遷大將軍左司馬。
units.en: Murong Huang, who had long admired him, freed him at once, named him palace director, then promoted him to senior major on his staff.
units.literal: Huang plain had heard Yu’s name; immediately ordered release his bonds; appointed Palace Director; promoted Grand General’s Left Major.

units.zh: 東破高句麗，北滅宇文歸，皆豫其謀，皝甚器重之。
units.en: He helped plan the eastern victory over Goguryeo and the northern destruction of Yuwen Gui, and Huang came to rely on him heavily.
units.literal: East defeated Goguryeo, north destroyed Yuwen Gui—both he pre-planned their strategies; Huang greatly prized and employed him.

units.zh: 及遷都和龍，裕雅有巧思，皝所制城池宮闔，皆裕之規模。
units.en: When the capital shifted to Helong, Yang Yu’s engineering shaped every wall and tower Murong Huang built.
units.literal: When moved the capital to Helong, Yu by nature had clever thought; the city walls and palace towers Huang regulated were all Yu’s models.

units.zh: 裕雖仕皝日近，寵秩在舊人之右，性謙恭清儉，剛簡慈篤，雖曆居朝端，若布衣之士。
units.en: Though he rose above older favorites, he lived modestly and treated everyone like a poor scholar.
units.literal: Although Yu served Huang daily nearer, favor and rank above the old men’s, nature humble and respectful, clear and frugal, firm, simple, kind, and earnest; although passed through dwelling at court’s apex, like a scholar in plain cloth.

units.zh: 士大夫流亡羈絕者，莫不經營收葬，存恤孤遺，士無賢不肖皆傾身待之，是以所在推仰。
units.en: He buried exiles, aided their orphans, and honored every gentleman he met, winning universal esteem.
units.literal: Grandees and scholars who fled in exile and were cut off—none he did not arrange burial for, preserve and pity orphans left behind; gentry whether worthy or not all he inclined his person to treat; therefore wherever he was was pushed and looked up to.

units.zh: 初，范陽盧諶每稱之曰：「吾及晉之清平，曆觀朝士多矣，忠清簡毅，篤信義烈，如陽士倫者，實亦未幾。」
units.en: Lu Chen of Fanyang once said, “In times of peace I have known many officials, but few match Yang Yu in loyalty, austerity, and steadfast faith.”
units.literal: In the beginning, Fan Yang’s Lu Chen always praised him, saying: “I have reached Jin’s clear peace, broadly viewed many court gentlemen; loyal, pure, concise, resolute, faithful in duty and fierce in righteousness—like Yang Shilun, in truth also not many.”

units.zh: 及死，皝甚悼之，時年六十二。
units.en: When he died at sixty-two, Murong Huang mourned him deeply.
units.literal: When he died, Huang greatly mourned him; at the time age sixty-two sui.

units.zh: 及石季龍死，裒上表請伐之，即日戒嚴，直指泗口。
units.en: After Shi Hu’s death Chu Pou memorialized for an expedition; the army mobilized the same day toward Sikou.
units.literal: When Shi Jilong died, Pou submitted a memorial requesting to campaign against his state; that very day martial law was declared, aiming straight at Sikou.

units.zh: 時石季龍新死，其國大亂，遺戶二十萬口渡河，將歸順，乞師救援。
units.en: Shi Hu had just died and his state was in chaos; two hundred thousand people crossed the Yellow River seeking Jin protection and begging for an army.
units.literal: At the time Shi Jilong had newly died; his state was greatly in chaos; leftover households two hundred thousand mouths crossed the river, about to submit in allegiance, begging troops for rescue.

units.zh: 於是推舉賢才，委以庶政，以河東裴嶷、代郡魯昌、北平陽耽為謀主，北海逢羨、廣平遊邃、北平西方虔、渤海封抽、西河宋奭、河東裴開為股肱，渤海封弈、平原宋該、安定皇甫岌、蘭陵繆愷以文章才俊任居樞要，會稽硃左車、太山胡毋翼、魯國孔纂以舊德清重引為賓友，平原劉贊儒學該通，引為東庠祭酒，其世子皝率國胄束修受業焉。
units.en: He therefore promoted men of talent and entrusted them with government: Pei Yi of Hedong, Lu Chang of Dai, and Yang Dan of Beiping served as his chief advisers; Feng Xian of Beihai, You Sui of Guangping, Xifang Qian of Beiping, Feng Chou of Bohai, Song Shi of Xihe, and Pei Kai of Hedong were his arms and legs; Feng Yi of Bohai, Song Gai of Pingyuan, Huangfu Ji of Anding, and Miao Kai of Lanling, all distinguished for literary talent and ability, held key posts; Zhu Zuoche of Kuaiji, Humu Yi of Taishan, and Kong Zuan of Lu, respected for their old virtue and pure standing, were brought in as guests and friends; and Liu Zan of Pingyuan, broadly learned in the classics, was appointed libationer of the Eastern Academy, where his heir Murong Huang led the sons of the state in bringing tuition gifts and receiving instruction.
units.literal: He promoted worthies to routine administration: Hedong Pei Yi, Dai commandery Lu Chang, Beiping Yang Dan as strategists; Beihai Feng Xian, Guangping You Sui, Beiping Xifang Qian, Bohai Feng Chou, Xihe Song Shi, Hedong Pei Kai as arms and legs; Bohai Feng Yi, Pingyuan Song Gai, Anding Huangfu Ji, Lanling Miao Kai held literary portfolios; Kuaiji Zhu Zuoche, Taishan Humu Yi, Lu state Kong Zuan served as honored guests; Pingyuan Liu Zan's erudition made him Libationer of the eastern school where heir Huang studied.

units.zh: 其後廆更寫前箋，並齎其東夷校尉封抽、行遼東相韓矯等三十餘人疏上侃府曰：
units.en: Murong coordinated a joint petition southward.
units.literal: Later Hui rewrote the earlier letter and together with Eastern Yi Colonel Feng Chou, acting Liaodong minister Han Jiao, and thirty others memorialized Tao Kan's headquarters:

units.zh: 侃報抽等書，其略曰：「車騎將軍憂國忘身，貢篚載路，羯賊求和，執使送之，西討段國，北伐塞外，遠綏索頭，荒服以獻。
units.en: Tao Kan praised Murong's loyalty and frontier victories in his reply, writing in gist: "The General of Chariots and Cavalry forgets self for the state—tribute baskets crowd the road; Jie bandits sued peace yet he handed envoys to court; he struck west at Duan lands, campaigned north beyond the passes, soothed Suotou tribes—distant desert peoples submitted tribute.
units.literal: Kan replied to Feng Chou's letter in gist: "General of Chariots and Cavalry forgets self for the state—tribute baskets crowd the road; Jie bandits sued peace yet he handed envoys to court; he struck west at Duan lands, campaigned north beyond the passes, soothed Suotou tribes—distant desert peoples submitted tribute."
